notes.title: [01/31] Patch Note
notes.notes:
Dear users,
A new patch has been updated.

- Bug Fixed: Unobtainable Trophy

notes.title: [01/23] Urgent Patch
notes.notes:
Dear users, 
An emergency fix patch has been updated.

Of the requests we received over the past day, these are the quickest fixes we could make.

1. Add Cutscene skips
2. Give HP potions at the spawn
3. You can return to the main menu after saving from the pause state
4. Description [Mutant Mode -> Easy Mode]
5. Weaker enemies in the early game

We promise to keep updating the game as best we can to ensure everyone.

Thank you for visiting the department store.

notes.title: DISORDER Release Date Revealed
notes.notes:
Greetings, everyone!

A new trailer has revealed the release date of DISORDER: January 22, 2025.

Our latest trailer features extensive new gameplay footage and in-game cinematics, all captured on PC.

DISORDER will be available on Windows PC, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S. 
You can now wishlist it on Steam and PS Store.

Thanks to everyone for your support, encouragement, and feedback. 

On January 22 next year, we look forward to seeing you there!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1332340/_/

notes.title: 《DISORDER》 release preview
notes.notes:
We've opened a Steam store page with a public trailer for "DISORDER"!

Trailers and screenshots include a lot of first-look game footage, all of which is actual gameplay and story footage.

[previewyoutube=L0RwEz51AyM;full][/previewyoutube]

The game will be released in Q4 2024 on Windows, PlayStation®5, and Xbox Series X|S platforms, and you can now sign up for Steam's wishlist!

Finally, thank you to everyone for your interest and encouragement over the past four years, and I look forward to seeing you at the end of this year!
